record.question: Which one of the following is different from the rest based on the method of reproduction in living organisms?
record.explanation: Answer D: Human. Amoeba and bacteria commonly reproduce by fission, Hydra by budding, while humans reproduce sexually; human is the distinct item by sexual versus asexual reproduction. Reference: https://openstax.org/books/biology-2e/pages/11-1-the-process-of-meiosis. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
